rows.summary: 3 atomic changes. Explicit sole-discretion designation materially increases franchisor control over the territory. Relocation consent now explicitly rests on franchisor sole discretion and adds general non-exclusive consent criteria.

oldEvidence.quote: However, the radius and/or shape of your Territory may be different based on specific market variables of your Location, including population, growth trends, affluence of nearby population, topography, geography, density, demographics, and number of qualified households and age range of core customers.

If you have not selected and we have not approved of the site Location when you sign the Franchise Agreement, then the Franchise Agreement will identify the search area within which you may search for your Location, and we will designate the Territory when you select and we approve of the Location.

You may relocate your Franchised Business with our written approval, and you may request our approval (which may be withheld at our sole discretion) for opening an additional Location within your Territory.

newEvidence.quote: We will determine and designate your Protected Territory as we deem appropriate, in our sole discretion.

The site selection area will be protected with the same protections we grant for a Protected Territory until the first to occur of the following: (1) we designate your Protected Territory; or (2) the deadline for opening your franchise pursuant to the Franchise Agreement.

You may relocate the Studio only with our prior consent, which may be withheld in our sole discretion. Generally, we will consent to relocation if, among other things in our sole discretion, your lease expires or terminates through no fault of your own or if the Premises is destroyed or materially damaged by fire, flood, or other casualty, and you are not in default of the Franchise Agreement or any other agreement with us.

rows.inferenceLimit: Do not infer that any particular territory was designated or denied under the new discretion. Do not infer that any franchisee actually received site selection area protection in practice. Do not infer that any relocation was approved or denied, or that the sole-discretion standard was exercised.
